decisions.reason: As an outpatient mental-health support service very close to the firm's existing therapeutic and psychosocial capabilities, and upgraded from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024, it fits the firm's knowledge base and shows signs of strategic traction.

Counseling for senior living is tightly linked to the firm's eldercare expertise and remained on the home page across both years, suggesting strong fit, easy learning from early demand, and low likelihood of withdrawal.

The retail shop extends the firm's sheltered-workshop and practical production know-how into a market-facing format, and its move to the home page in 2024 indicates the firm has been able to absorb and apply this related capability commercially.

Meal delivery for seniors is related to the firm's care offer and everyday-life support model, but as a very new service with only a website mention in 2024 and somewhat different logistical demands, it carries the highest near-term risk while still being worth retaining for now.
